title: Customer records leave in stages
story: An intruder has Mia Fischer's password (marketing, web-01). An old extra key for her account was put on web-01 before the restart.

During the shift it logs in as Mia from two addresses. First it takes one mailing list with the export tool, as marketing does. Later it uses the key, takes a second list while Mia is at work from home, tries to read settings files with sudo, and then takes all customers with the support look-up mode. At the end it removes the export files and the shell history.
notes: Bench version 2 (2026-11-11). Evidence in steps: see timeline.json notes. Damage: the exports leave 41 (0.17), 83 (0.35) and then all 240 customers (1.0). The limit 0.4 means: stop the intruder before the last export (+900). Before it, the defender has had evidence with no normal look-alike for 5 minutes (+600: two places at one time, a key that Mia never uses) and loud evidence for more than 2 minutes (+760: sudo refusals).
